annotations.title: Link an existing GitHub pull request

description: Link an existing accessible GitHub pull request to a finding identified by ODI-12 or findingId. This operation is idempotent. It does not create, modify, merge, or push a pull request, commit, or branch. Requires explicit user confirmation and an API key with Read & Write permission; cookie-authenticated callers also need member role.

findingId.description: Raw internal finding ID, useful when chaining from another tool.

identifier.description: Human-readable finding identifier such as "ODI-12". Preferred input.

url.description: Existing GitHub pull request URL to link to the finding.

name: link_finding_pull_request
title: Link an existing GitHub pull request
